name: watch_state
description: Keep durable structured watch baselines, compare new snapshots, and track completed or pending notification delivery without sending messages. Use for changes since a previous check, quiet first runs, new/changed/missing records, exact handled IDs, and operational watch health. Register a definition first; compare stages a run without moving the baseline; commit atomically advances that run and creates registered delivery intents. dry_run compare previews without writing. Before sending a pending intent, claim its channel/destination and retain the exact claim_token; ack only after an actual delivery result, with the same token. Failed delivery remains pending. Read list/inspect/history/health/pending/handled freely; writes require the watch's trusted owner workflow. Ownership comes from the executor, never tool arguments. Runs in the current cloud/local mode automatically; the two built-in movie/TV radar histories are shared. No network requests, scheduling, email, or push delivery are performed.

action.description: Operation. radar_history is reserved for the matching built-in upcoming_movie_radar or upcoming_tv_radar workflow and imports legacy emailed IDs. record_delivery is ledger-only, ever-handled deduplication per record ID/channel/destination; use claim/ack for repeated change events such as later price changes. It never sends. record_error saves a safe source-failure code without advancing the baseline. cleanup applies registered retention in bounded batches and preserves handled receipts.

key.description: Stable watch key; required except list and overall health/pending. Use the same key for later runs.

definition.description: register only. id_field identifies records; compare_fields selects compared paths (empty compares all nonignored fields), ignore_fields excludes volatile paths, normalizers configures deterministic normalization. complete/missing_grace control removals; quiet_first suppresses initial events. channels registers exact channel/destination intent targets. Does not configure a sender or schedule.

id_field.description: Stable record identity path, e.g. product_id or item.id. Exact IDs are preserved and cannot be normalized.

compare_fields.description: Compared dot-separated paths, e.g. price, stock.available. Empty compares all fields except ignored paths. Selects change detection only; full normalized records are stored.

ignore_fields.description: Paths excluded from change detection only. These fields remain in stored snapshots and event history; remove sensitive data from input records before calling.

normalizers.description: Explicit field-path normalization, e.g. {"price":{"type":"money","currency":"USD"},"name":"text","count":"number","released":"date"}. Money keeps currencies explicit; dates require ISO dates or timezone-qualified timestamps.

stale_after_seconds.description: Expected-check freshness threshold in seconds. Defaults to zero (no stale alerts). Set a positive interval explicitly for a scheduled watch.

records.description: compare only. Structured records from the current successful fetch. Do not turn a failed or incomplete fetch into an empty complete snapshot.

complete.description: compare only. Whether this run is a complete authoritative snapshot; incomplete runs must not infer missing records.

dry_run.description: compare only. Preview without storing a run or changing any state.

request_id.description: compare only. Stable retry identifier for this snapshot.

run_id.description: commit/discard only. Exact run_id returned by compare. discard cancels only this staged run without changing the baseline or committed pending deliveries.

event_id.description: claim/ack only. Exact event ID returned by pending/commit.

destination.description: Exact registered destination; for radar email use the actual resolved recipient from the sent-email receipt.

lease_seconds.description: claim only. Delivery lease duration, default 60 seconds. Send only when claimed=true and claim_token is present; an exhausted claim returns claimed=false with parked status.

claim_token.description: ack only. Exact claim token for this channel/destination; never invent or shorten it.

success.description: ack only. Whether delivery actually completed; false retains retryable pending state.

receipt.description: Actual delivery receipt for ack/record_delivery. Radar requires {ok:true,data:{status:'sent',to:actual_destination,...}} from the successful email step, never an invented success.

error.description: ack only. Safe bounded failure explanation without credentials.

error_code.description: record_error only. Short safe category, default source_fetch_failed. Never include raw exceptions, paths, tokens or provider payloads.

record.description: record_delivery only. Exact delivered record for the permanent per-record handled ledger; later changes to the same ID do not replace its first receipt. Use claim/ack for change events. Built-in radars use tmdb_id,title,tmdb_url,release_date or first_air_date and criteria.

include_parked.description: pending only. Include parked delivery intents.

limit.description: Paged reads; default 50. Follow next_offset for additional items.

until.description: mute only. Unix timestamp; zero unmutes. Omit both until and seconds for an indefinite mute.

seconds.description: mute only. Mute duration instead of until.

delete_handled.description: delete only. Clearing permanent handled history requires API administrator authority and is unavailable to the ordinary tool.
